oauth_replay_expiry.name: oauth_replay_expiry
columns:
(CASE WHEN json_valid("value") THEN CASE
    WHEN "key" GLOB 'oauth:dpop:jti:*'
      AND json_type("value", '$.exp') IN ('integer', 'real')
      AND json_type("value", '$.iat') IN ('integer', 'real')
      THEN MAX(CAST(json_extract("value", '$.exp') AS REAL), CAST(json_extract("value", '$.iat') AS REAL) + 300)
    WHEN "key" GLOB 'oauth:client-assertion:jti:*'
      AND json_type("value", '$.exp') IN ('integer', 'real')
      THEN CAST(json_extract("value", '$.exp') AS REAL)
    ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END)

space_personal_deletion_attempt_counts.name: space_personal_deletion_attempt_counts
space_personal_deletion_attempt_counts.value: "space_personal_deletion_attempt"."sequence" >= 0 AND "space_personal_deletion_attempt"."maximum_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND "space_personal_deletion_attempt"."expected_count" BETWEEN 0 AND "space_personal_deletion_attempt"."maximum_count" AND "space_personal_deletion_attempt"."expected_bytes" BETWEEN 0 AND 4194304
